procedure: Bind the frame, acceptance and existing evidence.
Prioritize material questions and competing explanations.
Specify discriminating sources/tests and domain-owned calibration.
Set stopping conditions and return the plans and gaps.

acceptance.expectation: Questions have stable IDs, source/test targets, stopping conditions and downstream work references; planned versus executed inquiries are distinguishable.
Priority and search scope follow decision consequences, access and credible counterevidence rather than a fixed source count.
Observation-to-assumption calibration is explicit; stopping cannot upgrade an unresolved reversible conclusion into an accepted recommendation.

conditions: Required source or execution tool unavailable
Acceptance test fails or remains unperformed
failure.record: failure_records; identify affected record, evidence/test, consequence, next action and conclusion restriction
